items.title: Hinton Milt — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Who else would be in their generation, like that … Sidney Mashay, would he be in that… or was he younger?

ctx.x: Yes. They were older then Louis.
They were older then Louis. Who else would be in their generation, like that … Sidney Mashay, would he be in that… or was he younger?
He was young but he didn‟t get to Chicago. He went another way.
